name: simplecast-mcp-server
description: Manage Simplecast podcasts and episodes and pull download/listener/technology/Web Player analytics from Claude.
long_description: Exposes the Simplecast Public API as MCP tools: browse podcasts, episodes, seasons, authors and keywords; read and update podcast metadata; and query download, listener, location, technology, time-of-week, Web Player (embed), and ad campaign analytics. Requires a Simplecast Private App API token.

api_token.title: Simplecast API Token
api_token.description: Your Simplecast Private App API token, from Simplecast → Account → Private Apps.
